한국어설명(Description Ko): 날카로운 침을 상대에게 발사해서 공격한다. 2-5회 동안 연속으로 쓴다.
영어설명(Description En): Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 촉수나 덩굴 등을 휘감아서 공격한다. 상대의 스피드를 떨어뜨릴 때가 있다.
영어설명(Description En): Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 머리를 비워서 순간적으로 무언가를 잊어버림으로써 자신의 특수방어를 크게 올린다.
영어설명(Description En): Raises the user's Special Defense by 2 stages.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 숟가락을 휘어서 주의를 끌어 상대의 명중률을 낮춘다.
영어설명(Description En): Lowers the target's accuracy by 1 stage.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 자신의 최대 HP 절반을 회복한다. 동료에게 HP를 나누어 줄 수도 있다.
영어설명(Description En): The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 점프해서 무릎차기로 상대를 공격한다. 빗나가면 자신이 데미지를 입는다.
영어설명(Description En): If this attack is not successful, the user loses half of its maximum HP, rounded down, as crash damage. Pokemon with the Magic Guard Ability are unaffected by crash damage.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 배의 무늬로 겁을 주어 상대를 마비 상태로 만든다.
영어설명(Description En): Paralyzes the target.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 잠자고 있는 상대의 꿈을 먹어 공격한다. 데미지의 절반을 HP로 회복한다.
영어설명(Description En): The target is unaffected by this move unless it is asleep. The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 독가스를 상대의 얼굴에 내뿜어 독 상태로 만든다.
영어설명(Description En): Poisons the target.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 둥근 것을 상대에게 내던져서 공격한다. 2-5회 동안 연속으로 쓴다.
영어설명(Description En): Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 피를 빨아서 상대를 공격한다. 준 데미지의 절반을 HP로 회복한다.
영어설명(Description En): The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 무서운 얼굴로 키스한다. 상대를 잠듦 상태로 만든다.
영어설명(Description En): Causes the target to fall asleep.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 2턴째에 상대를 공격한다. 가끔 풀죽게 만든다. 급소에도 맞기 쉽다.
영어설명(Description En): Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch and a higher chance for a critical hit. This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 상대 포켓몬으로 변신하여 상대와 완전히 똑같은 기술을 사용할 수 있다.
영어설명(Description En): The user transforms into the target. The target's current stats, stat stages, types, moves, Ability, weight, gender, and sprite are copied. The user's level and HP remain the same and each copied move receives only 5 PP, with a maximum of 5 PP each. The user can no longer change formes if it would have the ability to do so. This move fails if it hits a substitute, if either the user or the target is already transformed, or if either is behind an Illusion.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 매우 많은 거품을 상대에게 내뿜어 공격한다. 상대의 스피드를 떨어뜨릴 때가 있다.
영어설명(Description En): Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 리드미컬한 펀치를 날려 상대를 공격한다. 혼란시킬 때가 있다.
영어설명(Description En): Has a 20% chance to confuse the target.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 최면 효과가 있는 포자를 훌훌 흩뿌려서 상대를 잠듦 상태로 만든다.
영어설명(Description En): Causes the target to fall asleep.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 눈이 부신 빛으로 상대의 명중률을 떨어뜨린다.
영어설명(Description En): Lowers the target's accuracy by 1 stage.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 이상한 염력파를 상대에게 발사하여 공격한다. 사용할 때마다 데미지가 바뀐다.
영어설명(Description En): Deals damage to the target equal to (user's level) * (X + 50) / 100, where X is a random number from 0 to 100, rounded down, but not less than 1 HP.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 공격도 하지 않고 팔딱팔딱 튈 뿐 아무 일도 일어나지 않는다...
영어설명(Description En): No competitive use.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 세포의 변화로 액체가 되어 자신의 방어를 크게 올린다.
영어설명(Description En): Raises the user's Defense by 2 stages.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 큰 집게를 상대에게 내리쳐서 공격한다. 급소에 맞기 쉽다.
영어설명(Description En): Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 큰 폭발로 자신의 주위에 있는 포켓몬을 공격한다. 쓰고 나서는 기절한다.
영어설명(Description En): The user faints after using this move, even if this move fails for having no target. This move is prevented from executing if any active Pokemon has the Damp Ability.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 손톱이나 낫 등으로 상대를 할퀴어서 공격한다. 2-5회 동안 연속으로 쓴다.
영어설명(Description En): Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 손에 들고 있는 뼈를 상대에게 날려서 날아갈 때와 돌아올 때 2회 연속 데미지를 준다.
영어설명(Description En): Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 2턴 동안 계속 잠잔다. 자신의 HP와 상태 이상을 모두 회복한다.
영어설명(Description En): The user falls asleep for the next two turns and restores all of its HP, curing itself of any non-volatile status condition in the process. Fails if the user has full HP, is already asleep, or if another effect is preventing sleep.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 큰 바위를 세차게 부딪쳐서 공격한다. 상대를 풀죽게 만들 때가 있다.
영어설명(Description En): Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 날카로운 앞니로 강하게 물어서 공격한다. 상대를 풀죽게 만들 때가 있다.
영어설명(Description En): Has a 10% chance to make the target flinch.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 몸의 각을 늘려서 더욱 각지게 하여 자신의 공격을 올린다.
영어설명(Description En): Raises the user's Attack by 1 stage.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 자신의 타입을 배운 기술 중 가장 위에 있는 기술과 같은 타입으로 바꾼다.
영어설명(Description En): The user's type changes to match the original type of the move in its first move slot. Fails if the user cannot change its type, or if the type is one of the user's current types.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 3개의 광선으로 공격한다. 마비, 화상 또는 얼음 상태 중 어느 하나로 만들 때가 있다.
영어설명(Description En): Has a 20% chance to either burn, freeze, or paralyze the target.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 날카로운 앞니로 강하게 물어서 공격한다. 상대의 HP는 절반이 된다.
영어설명(Description En): Deals damage to the target equal to half of its current HP, rounded down, but not less than 1 HP.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 발톱이나 낫 등으로 상대를 베어 갈라서 공격한다. 급소에 맞기 쉽다.
영어설명(Description En): Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 자신의 HP를 조금 깎아서 분신을 만든다. 분신은 자신의 대타가 된다.
영어설명(Description En): The user takes 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, and puts it into a substitute to take its place in battle. The substitute is removed once enough damage is inflicted on it, if the user switches out or faints, or if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up. Baton Pass can be used to transfer the substitute to an ally, and the substitute will keep its remaining HP. Until the substitute is broken, it receives damage from all attacks made by other Pokemon and shields the user from status effects and stat stage changes caused by other Pokemon. Sound-based moves and Pokemon with the Infiltrator Ability ignore substitutes. The user still takes normal damage from weather and status effects while behind its substitute. If the substitute breaks during a multi-hit attack, the user will take damage from any remaining hits. If a substitute is created while the user is trapped by a binding move, the binding effect ends immediately. Fails if the user does not have enough HP remaining to create a substitute without fainting, or if it already has a substitute.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 자신의 PP가 떨어지면 발버둥 쳐 상대를 공격한다. 자신도 조금 데미지를 입는다.
영어설명(Description En): Deals typeless damage to a random opposing Pokemon. If this move was successful, the user loses 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded half up, and the Rock Head Ability does not prevent this. This move is automatically used if none of the user's known moves can be selected.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 상대가 쓴 기술을 자신의 것으로 만든다. 한 번 사용하면 스케치는 사라진다.
영어설명(Description En): This move is permanently replaced by the last move used by the target. The copied move has the maximum PP for that move. Fails if the target has not made a move, if the user has Transformed, or if the move is Blazing Torque, Combat Torque, Dark Void, Hyperspace Fury, Magical Torque, Noxious Torque, Revival Blessing, Sketch, Struggle, Tera Starstorm, Wicked Torque, or any move the user knows.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 3회 연속으로 킥을 날려 공격한다. 기술이 맞을 때마다 위력이 올라간다.
영어설명(Description En): Hits three times. Power increases to 20 for the second hit and 30 for the third. This move checks accuracy for each hit, and the attack ends if the target avoids a hit. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit three times.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 공격과 동시에 도구를 훔친다. 자신이 도구를 지니고 있을 경우에는 훔칠 수 없다.
영어설명(Description En): If this attack was successful and the user has not fainted, it steals the target's held item if the user is not holding one. A target with the Sticky Hold Ability does not lose its held item if it has not fainted. The target's item is not stolen if it is a Blue Orb, Red Orb, Adamant Crystal, Lustrous Globe, Griseous Core, Plate, Drive, Memory, Rusted Sword, Rusted Shield, Booster Energy, or Mask held by a Kyogre, Groudon, Dialga, Palkia, Giratina, Arceus, Genesect, Silvally, Zacian, Zamazenta, Paradox Pokemon, or Ogerpon, respectively, or if the user is one of those species and the target is holding the respective item. In this case, Paradox Pokemon include every species with the Protosynthesis and Quark Drive Abilities, except Gouging Fire, Raging Bolt, Iron Boulder, and Iron Crown. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 끈적끈적하고 가는 실을 칭칭 휘감아 상대를 배틀에서 도망칠 수 없게 한다.
영어설명(Description En): Prevents the target from switching out. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 상대의 움직임을 마음으로 읽고 다음 공격이 반드시 상대에게 명중되게 한다.
영어설명(Description En): Until the end of the next turn, the target cannot avoid the user's moves, even if the target is in the middle of a two-turn move. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field. Fails if this effect is active for the user.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 잠듦 상태의 상대에게 악몽을 꾸게 하여 매 턴 조금씩 HP를 떨어뜨려 간다.
영어설명(Description En): Causes the target to lose 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn as long as it is asleep. This move does not affect the target unless it is asleep. The effect ends when the target wakes up, even if it falls asleep again in the same turn.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 불꽃을 둘러 상대에게 돌진하여 공격한다. 화상 상태로 만들 때가 있다.
영어설명(Description En): Has a 10% chance to burn the target.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 자신이 잠들어있을 때 소음을 내어 공격한다. 상대를 풀죽게 만들 때가 있다.
영어설명(Description En): Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch. Fails if the user is not asleep.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 기술을 쓰는 포켓몬이 고스트타입일 때와 그 이외의 타입일 때는 효과가 다르다.
영어설명(Description En): If the user is not a Ghost type, lowers the user's Speed by 1 stage and raises the user's Attack and Defense by 1 stage. If the user is a Ghost type, the user loses 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded down and even if it would cause fainting, in exchange for the target losing 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn while it is active. If the target uses Baton Pass, the replacement will continue to be affected. Fails if there is no target or if the target is already affected.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 바둥바둥 난동 부려서 공격한다. 자신의 HP가 적을수록 기술의 위력이 올라간다.
영어설명(Description En): The power of this move is 20 if X is 33 to 48, 40 if X is 17 to 32, 80 if X is 10 to 16, 100 if X is 5 to 9, 150 if X is 2 to 4, and 200 if X is 0 or 1, where X is equal to (user's current HP * 48 / user's maximum HP), rounded down.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 상대가 마지막으로 쓴 기술에 저항할 수 있도록 자신의 타입을 변화시킨다.
영어설명(Description En): The user's type changes to match a type that resists or is immune to the type of the last move used by the target, but not either of its current types. The determined type of the move is used rather than the original type. Fails if the target has not made a move, if the user cannot change its type, or if this move would only be able to select one of the user's current types.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 공기의 소용돌이를 발사하여 공격한다. 급소에 맞기 쉽다.
영어설명(Description En): Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 솜처럼 폭신폭신한 포자를 착 달라붙게 해서 상대의 스피드를 크게 떨어뜨린다.
영어설명(Description En): Lowers the target's Speed by 2 stages.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 힘을 쥐어짜서 공격한다. 자신의 HP가 적을수록 기술의 위력이 올라간다.
영어설명(Description En): The power of this move is 20 if X is 33 to 48, 40 if X is 17 to 32, 80 if X is 10 to 16, 100 if X is 5 to 9, 150 if X is 2 to 4, and 200 if X is 0 or 1, where X is equal to (user's current HP * 48 / user's maximum HP), rounded down.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 상대가 마지막으로 사용한 기술에 원한을 품어 그 기술의 PP를 4만큼 줄인다.
영어설명(Description En): Causes the target's last move used to lose 4 PP. Fails if the target has not made a move, if the move has 0 PP, or if it no longer knows the move.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 차가운 가랑눈을 상대에게 내뿜어 공격한다. 얼음 상태로 만들 때가 있다.
영어설명(Description En): Has a 10% chance to freeze the target.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 상대의 공격을 전혀 받지 않는다. 연속으로 쓰면 실패하기 쉽다.
영어설명(Description En): The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 눈에 보이지 않는 굉장한 속도로 펀치를 날린다. 반드시 선제공격을 할 수 있다.
영어설명(Description En): No additional effect.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 무서운 얼굴로 노려보고 겁주어 상대의 스피드를 크게 떨어뜨린다.
영어설명(Description En): Lowers the target's Speed by 2 stages.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 슬금슬금 상대에게 다가가 방심한 틈을 타서 세게 때린다. 공격은 반드시 명중한다.
영어설명(Description En): This move does not check accuracy.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 천사처럼 귀엽게 키스하여 상대를 혼란시킨다.
영어설명(Description En): Causes the target to become confused.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 자신의 HP를 최대 HP의 절반만큼 감소시켜 자신의 공격을 최대로 올린다.
영어설명(Description En): Raises the user's Attack by 12 stages in exchange for the user losing 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded down. Fails if the user would faint or if its Attack stat stage is 6.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 더러운 오물을 상대에게 내던져서 공격한다. 독 상태로 만들 때가 있다.
영어설명(Description En): Has a 30% chance to poison the target.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 상대의 얼굴 등에 진흙을 내던져서 공격한다. 명중률을 떨어뜨린다.
영어설명(Description En): Has a 100% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1 stage.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 상대의 얼굴 등에 먹물을 내뿜어 공격한다. 명중률을 떨어뜨릴 때가 있다.
영어설명(Description En): Has a 50% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1 stage.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 상대의 발밑에 압정을 뿌린다. 교체된 상대 포켓몬에게 데미지를 준다.

영어설명(Description En): No additional effect.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 원시의 힘으로 공격한다. 자신의 모든 능력이 오를 때가 있다.
영어설명(Description En): Has a 10% chance to raise the user's Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 1 stage.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 까만 그림자의 덩어리를 내던져서 공격한다. 상대의 특수방어를 떨어뜨릴 때가 있다.
영어설명(Description En): Has a 20% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 기술을 사용한 2턴 뒤에 상대에게 염동력의 덩어리를 보내어 공격한다.
영어설명(Description En): Deals damage two turns after this move is used. At the end of that turn, the damage is calculated at that time and dealt to the Pokemon at the position the target had when the move was used. If the user is no longer active at the time, damage is calculated based on the user's natural Special Attack stat, types, and level, with no boosts from its held item or Ability. Fails if this move or Doom Desire is already in effect for the target's position.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 펀치로 공격한다. 상대의 방어를 떨어뜨릴 때가 있다. 바위를 깰 수도 있다.
영어설명(Description En): Has a 50% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 세차게 소용돌이치는 물속에 4-5턴 동안 상대를 가두어 공격한다.
영어설명(Description En): Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 같은 편 전원이 공격한다. 동료 포켓몬이 많을수록 기술의 공격 횟수가 증가한다.
영어설명(Description En): Hits one time for the user and one time for each unfainted Pokemon without a non-volatile status condition in the user's party. The power of each hit is equal to 5+(X/10), where X is each participating Pokemon's base Attack; each hit is considered to come from the user.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 선제공격으로 상대를 풀죽게 한다. 배틀에 나가서 바로 쓰지 않으면 성공할 수 없다.
영어설명(Description En): Has a 100% chance to make the target flinch. Fails unless it is the user's first turn on the field.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 3턴 동안 소란 피워 공격한다. 그 동안은 아무도 잠들지 않게 된다.
영어설명(Description En): The user spends three turns locked into this move. This move targets an opponent at random on each turn. On the first of the three turns, all sleeping active Pokemon wake up. During the three turns, no active Pokemon can fall asleep by any means, and Pokemon switched in during the effect do not wake up. If the user is prevented from moving or the attack is not successful against the target during one of the turns, the effect ends.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 힘을 비축해서 자신의 방어와 특수방어를 올린다. 최대 3회까지 비축할 수 있다.
영어설명(Description En): Raises the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage. The user's Stockpile count increases by 1. Fails if the user's Stockpile count is 3. The user's Stockpile count is reset to 0 when it is no longer active.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 비축된 힘을 상대에게 부딪쳐서 공격한다. 비축된 만큼 위력이 올라간다.
영어설명(Description En): Power is equal to 100 times the user's Stockpile count. Fails if the user's Stockpile count is 0. Whether or not this move is successful, the user's Defense and Special Defense decrease by as many stages as Stockpile had increased them, and the user's Stockpile count resets to 0.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 비축된 힘을 꿀꺽해서 자신의 HP를 회복한다. 비축된 만큼 회복한다.
영어설명(Description En): The user restores its HP based on its Stockpile count. Restores 1/4 of its maximum HP if it's 1, 1/2 of its maximum HP if it's 2, both rounded half down, and all of its HP if it's 3. Fails if the user's Stockpile count is 0. The user's Defense and Special Defense decrease by as many stages as Stockpile had increased them, and the user's Stockpile count resets to 0.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 뜨거운 숨결을 상대에게 내뿜어 공격한다. 화상 상태로 만들 때가 있다.
영어설명(Description En): Has a 10% chance to burn the target.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 5턴 동안 싸라기눈을 내리게 해 얼음타입이 아닌 포켓몬 모두에게 데미지를 준다.
영어설명(Description En): For 5 turns, the weather becomes Hail. At the end of each turn except the last, all active Pokemon lose 1/16 of their maximum HP, rounded down, unless they are an Ice type or have the Ice Body, Magic Guard, Overcoat, or Snow Cloak Abilities. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Icy Rock. Fails if the current weather is Hail.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 상대에게 트집을 잡아서 똑같은 기술을 2회 연속으로 쓸 수 없게 한다.
영어설명(Description En): Prevents the target from selecting the same move for use two turns in a row. This effect ends when the target is no longer active.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 상대를 부추겨서 혼란시킨다. 동시에 상대의 특수공격도 올라가 버린다.
영어설명(Description En): Raises the target's Special Attack by 1 stage and confuses it.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 으스스하고 괴상한 불꽃을 쏘아 상대를 화상 상태로 만든다.
영어설명(Description En): Burns the target.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 자신은 기절하게 되지만 그 대신 상대의 공격과 특수공격을 크게 떨어뜨린다.
영어설명(Description En): Lowers the target's Attack and Special Attack by 2 stages. The user faints unless this move misses or there is no target. Fails entirely if this move hits a substitute, but does not fail if the target's stats cannot be changed.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 자신이 독, 마비, 화상 상태일 때 날리면 기술의 위력이 2배가 된다.
영어설명(Description En): Power doubles if the user is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned. The physical damage halving effect from the user's burn is ignored.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 정신력을 높여 펀치를 날린다. 기술을 쓰기 전에 공격을 받으면 실패한다.
영어설명(Description En): The user loses its focus and does nothing if it is hit by a damaging attack this turn before it can execute the move.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 마비 상태의 상대에게는 위력이 2배가 되지만 대신 상대의 마비가 풀린다.
영어설명(Description En): Power doubles if the target is paralyzed. If the user has not fainted, the target is cured of paralysis.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 자신에게 주목시켜 상대로부터의 공격을 모두 자신에게 향하게 한다.
영어설명(Description En): Until the end of the turn, all single-target attacks from the opposing side are redirected to the user. Such attacks are redirected to the user before they can be reflected by Magic Coat or the Magic Bounce Ability, or drawn in by the Lightning Rod or Storm Drain Abilities. Fails if it is not a Double Battle or Battle Royal. This effect is ignored while the user is under the effect of Sky Drop.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 자연의 힘으로 공격한다. 사용하는 장소에 따라 나오는 기술이 변화한다.
영어설명(Description En): This move calls another move for use based on the battle terrain. Tri Attack on the regular Wi-Fi terrain, Thunderbolt during Electric Terrain, Moonblast during Misty Terrain, Energy Ball during Grassy Terrain, and Psychic during Psychic Terrain.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 다음 턴에 쓸 전기타입 기술의 위력을 올린다. 자신의 특수방어도 올라간다.
영어설명(Description En): Raises the user's Special Defense by 1 stage. The user's next Electric-type attack will have its power doubled; the effect ends when the user is no longer active, or after the user attempts to use any Electric-type move besides Charge, even if it is not successful.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 상대를 화나게 한다. 3턴 동안 상대는 데미지를 주는 기술밖에 쓸 수 없게 된다.
영어설명(Description En): Prevents the target from using non-damaging moves for its next three turns. Pokemon with the Oblivious Ability or protected by the Aroma Veil Ability are immune.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 동료를 돕는다. 도움받은 포켓몬이 쓰는 기술의 위력은 여느 때보다 커진다.
영어설명(Description En): The power of the target's attack this turn is multiplied by 1.5 (this effect is stackable). Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user or if the ally already moved this turn, but does not fail if the ally is using a two-turn move.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 상대의 빈틈을 노려 자신과 상대가 지닌 물건을 교환한다.
영어설명(Description En): The user swaps its held item with the target's held item. Fails if both the user and the target have no held item, or if the user is trying to give or take a Blue Orb, Red Orb, Adamant Crystal, Lustrous Globe, Griseous Core, Plate, Drive, Memory, Rusted Sword, Rusted Shield, Booster Energy, or Mask to or from a Kyogre, Groudon, Dialga, Palkia, Giratina, Arceus, Genesect, Silvally, Zacian, Zamazenta, Paradox Pokemon, or Ogerpon, respectively. In this case, Paradox Pokemon include every species with the Protosynthesis and Quark Drive Abilities, except Gouging Fire, Raging Bolt, Iron Boulder, and Iron Crown. The target is immune to this move if it has the Sticky Hold Ability.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 상대의 역할을 하여 자신도 상대와 같은 특성으로 변화한다.
영어설명(Description En): The user's Ability changes to match the target's Ability. Fails if the user's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Zen Mode, Zero to Hero, or already matches the target, or if the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Flower Gift, Forecast, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Trace, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 다음 턴에 자신의 HP를 최대 HP의 절반만큼 회복한다.
영어설명(Description En): At the end of the next turn, the Pokemon at the user's position has 1/2 of the user's maximum HP restored to it, rounded down. Fails if this move is already in effect for the user's position.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 서둘러서 같은 편의 도움을 받아 교대 포켓몬이 기억하고 있는 기술 중 하나를 쓴다.
영어설명(Description En): A random move among those known by the user's party members is selected for use. Does not select Assist, Baneful Bunker, Beak Blast, Belch, Bestow, Blazing Torque, Bounce, Celebrate, Chatter, Circle Throw, Combat Torque, Copycat, Counter, Covet, Destiny Bond, Detect, Dig, Dive, Dragon Tail, Endure, Feint, Fly, Focus Punch, Follow Me, Helping Hand, Hold Hands, King's Shield, Magical Torque, Mat Block, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Coat, Mirror Move, Nature Power, Noxious Torque, Phantom Force, Protect, Rage Powder, Roar, Shadow Force, Shell Trap, Sketch, Sky Drop, Sleep Talk, Snatch, Spiky Shield, Spotlight, Struggle, Switcheroo, Tera Starstorm, Thief, Transform, Trick, Whirlwind, or Wicked Torque.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 대지에 뿌리를 박아 매 턴마다 자신의 HP를 회복한다. 뿌리 박고 있으므로 교체할 수 없다.
영어설명(Description En): The user has 1/16 of its maximum HP restored at the end of each turn, but it is prevented from switching out and other Pokemon cannot force the user to switch out. The user can still switch out if it uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. If the user leaves the field using Baton Pass, the replacement will remain trapped and still receive the healing effect. During the effect, the user can be hit normally by Ground-type attacks and be affected by Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Sticky Web, even if the user is a Flying type or has the Levitate Ability.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 엄청난 힘을 발휘하여 상대를 공격한다. 자신의 공격과 방어가 떨어진다.
영어설명(Description En): Lowers the user's Attack and Defense by 1 stage.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 상대가 상태 이상이 되는 기술이나 씨뿌리기 등을 썼을 때 되받아친다.
영어설명(Description En): Until the end of the turn, the user is unaffected by certain non-damaging moves directed at it and will instead use such moves against the original user. Moves reflected in this way are unable to be reflected again by this or the Magic Bounce Ability's effect. Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, and Toxic Spikes can only be reflected once per side, by the leftmost Pokemon under this or the Magic Bounce Ability's effect. The Lightning Rod and Storm Drain Abilities redirect their respective moves before this move takes effect.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 배틀 중에 사용하여 없어진 자신의 지닌 물건을 재생시켜 사용할 수 있게 한다.
영어설명(Description En): The user regains the item it last used. Fails if the user is holding an item, if the user has not held an item, if the item was a popped Air Balloon, if the item was picked up by a Pokemon with the Pickup Ability, or if the item was lost to Bug Bite, Corrosive Gas, Covet, Incinerate, Knock Off, Pluck, or Thief. Items thrown with Fling can be regained.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 상대에게 기술을 받으면 그 상대에게 주는 데미지가 2배가 된다.
영어설명(Description En): Power doubles if the user was hit by the target this turn.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 수도로 기세 좋게 내려쳐서 상대를 공격한다. 빛의장막이나 리플렉터도 파괴할 수 있다.
영어설명(Description En): If this attack does not miss, the effects of Reflect, Light Screen, and Aurora Veil end for the target's side of the field before damage is calculated.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 큰 하품으로 졸음을 유도한다. 다음 턴에 상대를 잠듦 상태로 만든다.
영어설명(Description En): Causes the target to fall asleep at the end of the next turn. Fails when used if the target cannot fall asleep or if it already has a non-volatile status condition. At the end of the next turn, if the target is still active, does not have a non-volatile status condition, and can fall asleep, it falls asleep. If the target becomes affected, this effect cannot be prevented by Safeguard or a substitute, or by falling asleep and waking up during the effect.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 상대의 지닌 물건을 탁 쳐서 떨어뜨려 배틀이 끝날 때까지 사용할 수 없게 한다. 물건을 가진 상대에게는 데미지를 더 준다.
영어설명(Description En): This move's power is multiplied by 1.5 if the target is holding an item, and the target loses its held item if the user has not fainted. A target with the Sticky Hold Ability does not lose its held item if it has not fainted. This move does not increase in power or remove the target's item if it is a Blue Orb, Red Orb, Adamant Crystal, Lustrous Globe, Griseous Core, Plate, Drive, Memory, Rusted Sword, Rusted Shield, Booster Energy, or Mask held by a Kyogre, Groudon, Dialga, Palkia, Giratina, Arceus, Genesect, Silvally, Zacian, Zamazenta, Paradox Pokemon, or Ogerpon, respectively, or if the user is one of those species and the target is holding the respective item. In this case, Paradox Pokemon include every species with the Protosynthesis and Quark Drive Abilities, except Gouging Fire, Raging Bolt, Iron Boulder, and Iron Crown. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 상대의 HP가 자신의 HP와 같아지도록 데미지를 준다.
영어설명(Description En): Deals damage to the target equal to (target's current HP - user's current HP). The target is unaffected if its current HP is less than or equal to the user's current HP.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 분노를 폭발시켜 상대를 공격한다. 자신의 HP가 적을수록 기술의 위력이 떨어진다.
영어설명(Description En): Power is equal to (user's current HP * 150 / user's maximum HP), rounded down, but not less than 1.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 초능력으로 자신의 특성과 상대의 특성을 바꾼다.
영어설명(Description En): The user swaps its Ability with the target's Ability. Fails if either the user or the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 상대가 자신과 같은 기술을 기억하고 있으면 상대만 그 기술을 사용할 수 없게 한다.
영어설명(Description En): The user prevents all opposing Pokemon from using any moves that the user also knows as long as the user remains active.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 몸을 쉬게 하여 자신이 입은 독, 마비, 화상의 상태 이상을 치료한다.
영어설명(Description En): The user cures its burn, poison, or paralysis. Fails if the user is not burned, poisoned, or paralyzed.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 상대의 기술로 기절하면 원념을 담아 그 기술의 PP를 0으로 만든다.
영어설명(Description En): Until the user's next turn, if an opposing Pokemon's attack knocks the user out, that move loses all its remaining PP.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 상대가 사용하려고 한 회복 기술이나 능력 변화의 기술을 빼앗아 자신에게 쓴다.
영어설명(Description En): If another Pokemon uses certain non-damaging moves this turn, the user steals that move to use itself. If multiple Pokemon use one of those moves this turn, the applicable moves are all stolen by the first Pokemon in turn order that used this move this turn. This effect is ignored while the user is under the effect of Sky Drop.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 비밀의 힘으로 상대를 공격한다. 사용 장소에 따라 추가 효과가 변화한다.
영어설명(Description En): Has a 30% chance to cause a secondary effect on the target based on the battle terrain. Causes paralysis on the regular Wi-Fi terrain, causes paralysis during Electric Terrain, lowers Special Attack by 1 stage during Misty Terrain, causes sleep during Grassy Terrain and lowers Speed by 1 stage during Psychic Terrain.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 1턴째에 잠수했다가 2턴째에 떠올라 공격한다.
영어설명(Description En): This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. On the first turn, the user avoids all attacks other than Surf and Whirlpool but takes double damage from them, and is also unaffected by weather. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 펼친 양손으로 상대를 번갈아 쳐서 공격한다. 2-5회 동안 연속으로 쓴다.
영어설명(Description En): Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 물가나 풀밭, 동굴 등 있는 장소에 맞춰서 자신의 타입을 바꾼다.
영어설명(Description En): The user's type changes based on the battle terrain. Normal type on the regular Wi-Fi terrain, Electric type during Electric Terrain, Fairy type during Misty Terrain, Grass type during Grassy Terrain, and Psychic type during Psychic Terrain. Fails if the user's type cannot be changed or if the user is already purely that type.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 깜빡거리는 빛을 바라보고 자신의 정신을 통일하여 특수공격을 매우 크게 올린다.
영어설명(Description En): Raises the user's Special Attack by 3 stages.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 눈부신 빛을 발산하여 공격한다. 상대의 특수방어를 떨어뜨릴 때가 있다.
영어설명(Description En): Has a 50% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 안개의 깃털로 둘러싸 공격한다. 상대의 특수공격을 떨어뜨릴 때가 있다.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 몸을 고속으로 회전시켜 몸통박치기한다. 상대보다 스피드가 낮을수록 위력은 올라간다.
영어설명(Description En): Power is equal to (25 * target's current Speed / user's current Speed) + 1, rounded down, but not more than 150. If the user's current Speed is 0, this move's power is 1.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 자신은 기절하지만 교대하여 나오는 포켓몬의 상태 이상과 HP를 회복한다.
영어설명(Description En): The user faints, and if the Pokemon brought out to replace it does not have full HP or has a non-volatile status condition, its HP is fully restored along with having any non-volatile status condition cured. The replacement is sent out at the end of the turn, and the healing happens before hazards take effect. This effect continues until a Pokemon that meets either of these conditions switches in at the user's position or gets swapped into the position with Ally Switch. Fails if the user is the last unfainted Pokemon in its party.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 상대가 HP의 절반 정도 상처를 입고 있으면 기술의 위력이 2배가 된다.
영어설명(Description En): Power doubles if the target has less than or equal to half of its maximum HP remaining.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 나무열매에서 힘을 얻어 공격한다. 지니게 한 나무열매에 따라 기술의 타입과 위력이 바뀐다.
영어설명(Description En): The type and power of this move depend on the user's held Berry, and the Berry is lost. Fails if the user is not holding a Berry, if the user has the Klutz Ability, or if Embargo or Magic Room is in effect for the user.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 방어나 판별을 하고 있는 상대에게 공격할 수 있다. 방어 효과를 해제시킨다.
영어설명(Description En): If this move is successful, it breaks through the target's Baneful Bunker, Detect, King's Shield, Protect, or Spiky Shield for this turn, allowing other Pokemon to attack the target normally. If the target's side is protected by Crafty Shield, Mat Block, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard, that protection is also broken for this turn and other Pokemon may attack the target's side normally.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 부리로 공격한다. 상대가 나무열매를 지니고 있을 때 먹어서 나무열매의 효과를 받을 수 있다.
영어설명(Description En): If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, it steals the target's held Berry if it is holding one and eats it immediately, gaining its effects even if the user's item is being ignored. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 세차게 불어대는 바람의 소용돌이를 만들어 4턴 동안 같은 편 모두의 스피드를 올린다.
영어설명(Description En): For 4 turns, the user and its party members have their Speed doubled. Fails if this move is already in effect for the user's side.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 경혈을 눌러 몸을 활성화시킨다. 능력 중 하나를 크게 올린다.
영어설명(Description En): Raises a random stat by 2 stages as long as the stat is not already at stage 6. The user can choose to use this move on itself or an adjacent ally. Fails if no stat stage can be raised or if used on an ally with a substitute.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 기술을 쓰기 전에 마지막으로 받은 기술의 데미지를 늘려서 기술을 쓴 상대에게 돌려준다.
영어설명(Description En): Deals damage to the last opposing Pokemon to hit the user with a physical or special attack this turn equal to 1.5 times the HP lost by the user from that attack, rounded down. If the user did not lose HP from that attack, this move deals 1 HP of damage instead. If that opposing Pokemon's position is no longer in use and there is another opposing Pokemon on the field, the damage is done to it instead. Only the last hit of a multi-hit attack is counted. Fails if the user was not hit by an opposing Pokemon's physical or special attack this turn.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 공격한 뒤 굉장한 스피드로 돌아와서 교대 포켓몬과 교체한다.
영어설명(Description En): If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members, or if the target switched out using an Eject Button or through the effect of the Emergency Exit or Wimp Out Abilities.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 방어를 포기하고 상대 깊숙이 돌격한다. 자신의 방어와 특수방어가 떨어진다.
영어설명(Description En): Lowers the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 모아서 공격한다. 상대보다 뒤에 공격할 수 있으면 기술의 위력은 2배가 된다.
영어설명(Description En): Power doubles if the user moves after the target this turn, including actions taken through Instruct or the Dancer Ability. Switching in does not count as an action.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 그 턴에 상대가 이미 데미지를 입었다면 기술의 위력은 2배가 된다.
영어설명(Description En): Power doubles if the target has already taken damage this turn, other than direct damage from Belly Drum, confusion, Curse, or Pain Split.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 지니게 한 도구를 쓸 수 없게 한다. 트레이너도 그 포켓몬에게는 도구를 쓸 수 없다.
영어설명(Description En): For 5 turns, the target's held item has no effect. An item's effect of causing forme changes is unaffected, but any other effects from such items are negated. During the effect, Fling and Natural Gift are prevented from being used by the target. Items thrown at the target with Fling will still activate for it. If the target uses Baton Pass, the replacement will remain unable to use items.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 지니게 한 도구를 재빠르게 내던져서 공격한다. 도구에 따라 위력과 효과가 바뀐다.
영어설명(Description En): The power of this move is based on the user's held item. The held item is lost and it activates for the target if applicable. If there is no target or the target avoids this move by protecting itself, the user's held item is still lost. The user can regain a thrown item with Recycle or the Harvest Ability. Fails if the user has no held item, if the held item cannot be thrown, if the user is under the effect of Embargo or Magic Room, or if the user has the Klutz Ability.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 초능력으로 암시를 걸어서 자신에게 걸려 있는 상태 이상을 상대에게 옮긴다.
영어설명(Description En): The user's non-volatile status condition is transferred to the target, and the user is then cured. Fails if the user has no non-volatile status condition or if the target already has one.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 마지막수단의 남은 PP가 적으면 적을수록 기술의 위력이 올라간다.
영어설명(Description En): The power of this move is based on the amount of PP remaining after normal PP reduction and the Pressure Ability resolve. 200 power for 0 PP, 80 power for 1 PP, 60 power for 2 PP, 50 power for 3 PP, and 40 power for 4 or more PP.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 5턴 동안 기술이나 특성, 지니고 있는 도구에 의한 HP 회복을 할 수 없게 한다.
영어설명(Description En): For 5 turns, the target is prevented from restoring any HP as long as it remains active. During the effect, healing and draining moves are unusable, and Abilities and items that grant healing will not heal the user. If an affected Pokemon uses Baton Pass, the replacement will remain unable to restore its HP. Pain Split and the Regenerator Ability are unaffected.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 강하게 조여 공격을 한다. 상대의 HP가 많이 남아 있을수록 위력이 올라간다.
영어설명(Description En): Power is equal to 120 * (target's current HP / target's maximum HP), rounded half down, but not less than 1.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 초능력으로 자신의 공격과 방어의 힘을 교환한다.
영어설명(Description En): The user swaps its Attack and Defense stats, and stat stage changes remain on their respective stats. This move can be used again to swap the stats back. If the user uses Baton Pass, the replacement will have its Attack and Defense stats swapped if the effect is active. If the user has its stats recalculated by changing forme while its stats are swapped, this effect is ignored but is still active for the purposes of Baton Pass.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 상대의 몸에 위액을 내뱉는다. 달라붙은 위액은 상대의 특성 효과를 지운다.
영어설명(Description En): Causes the target's Ability to be rendered ineffective as long as it remains active. If the target uses Baton Pass, the replacement will remain under this effect. If the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero, this move fails, and receiving the effect through Baton Pass ends the effect immediately.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 하늘을 향해 기도를 올려 상대의 공격을 급소에 맞지 않게 한다.
영어설명(Description En): For 5 turns, the user and its party members cannot be struck by a critical hit. Fails if the effect is already active on the user's side.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 위력을 올려 상대가 쓰려고 하는 기술을 먼저 쓴다. 먼저 쓰지 않으면 실패한다.
영어설명(Description En): The user uses the move the target chose for use this turn against it, if possible, with its power multiplied by 1.5. The move must be a damaging move other than Beak Blast, Belch, Blazing Torque, Combat Torque, Comeuppance, Counter, Covet, Focus Punch, Magical Torque, Me First, Metal Burst, Mirror Coat, Noxious Torque, Shell Trap, Struggle, Thief, or Wicked Torque. Fails if the target moves before the user. Ignores the target's substitute for the purpose of copying the move.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 직전에 나온 기술을 흉내 내어 같은 기술을 쓴다. 기술이 나오지 않았으면 실패한다.
영어설명(Description En): The user uses the last move used by any Pokemon, including itself. Fails if no move has been used, or if the last move used was Assist, Baneful Bunker, Beak Blast, Behemoth Bash, Behemoth Blade, Belch, Bestow, Blazing Torque, Celebrate, Chatter, Circle Throw, Combat Torque, Copycat, Counter, Covet, Destiny Bond, Detect, Dragon Tail, Dynamax Cannon, Endure, Feint, Focus Punch, Follow Me, Helping Hand, Hold Hands, King's Shield, Magical Torque, Mat Block, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Move, Nature Power, Noxious Torque, Protect, Rage Powder, Roar, Shell Trap, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Snatch, Spiky Shield, Spotlight, Struggle, Switcheroo, Tera Starstorm, Thief, Transform, Trick, Whirlwind, or Wicked Torque.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 초능력으로 자신과 상대의 공격과 특수공격의 능력 변화를 교체한다.
영어설명(Description En): The user swaps its Attack and Special Attack stat stage changes with the target.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 초능력으로 자신과 상대의 방어와 특수방어의 능력 변화를 교체한다.
영어설명(Description En): The user swaps its Defense and Special Defense stat stage changes with the target.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 능력 변화로 상대가 파워업한 만큼 기술의 위력이 올라간다.
영어설명(Description En): Power is equal to 60+(X*20), where X is the target's total stat stage changes that are greater than 0, but not more than 200 power.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 배틀 중에 기억하고 있는 기술을 모두 사용하면 그때부터 쓸 수 있는 필살기이다.
영어설명(Description En): This move fails unless the user knows this move and at least one other move, and has used all the other moves it knows at least once each since it became active or Transformed.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 마음을 괴롭히는 씨앗을 심는다. 상대를 잠잘 수 없게 해서 특성을 불면으로 만든다.
영어설명(Description En): Causes the target's Ability to become Insomnia. Fails if the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Insomnia, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Truant, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 상대보다 먼저 공격할 수 있다. 상대가 쓴 기술이 공격기술이 아니면 실패한다.
영어설명(Description En): Fails if the target did not select a physical attack, special attack, or Me First for use this turn, or if the target moves before the user.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 상대의 발밑에 독압정을 뿌린다. 교체로 나온 상대 포켓몬에 독을 덮어씌운다.
영어설명(Description En): Sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, poisoning each opposing Pokemon that switches in, unless it is a Flying-type Pokemon or has the Levitate Ability. Can be used up to two times before failing. Opposing Pokemon become poisoned with one layer and badly poisoned with two layers. Can be removed from the opposing side if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up, or if any opposing Pokemon uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Defog successfully, is hit by Defog, or a grounded Poison-type Pokemon switches in. Safeguard prevents the opposing party from being poisoned on switch-in, but a substitute does not.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 초능력으로 자신과 상대에 걸려있는 능력 변화를 교체한다.
영어설명(Description En): The user swaps all its stat stage changes with the target.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 자신의 몸 주변을 물로 만든 베일로 덮는다. 매 턴 HP를 회복한다.
영어설명(Description En): The user has 1/16 of its maximum HP, rounded down, restored at the end of each turn while it remains active. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down. If the user uses Baton Pass, the replacement will receive the healing effect.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 전기로 만든 자력의 힘으로 허공에 뜬다. 5턴 동안 부유할 수 있다.
영어설명(Description En): For 5 turns, the user is immune to Ground-type attacks and the effects of Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web, and the Arena Trap Ability as long as it remains active. If the user uses Baton Pass, the replacement will gain the effect. Ingrain, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows, and Iron Ball override this move if the user is under any of their effects. Fails if the user is already under this effect or the effects of Ingrain, Smack Down, or Thousand Arrows.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 불꽃을 두르고 돌진한다. 자신도 상당한 데미지를 입는다. 화상 상태로 만들 때가 있다.
영어설명(Description En): Has a 10% chance to burn the target. If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 상대의 몸에 충격파를 부딪쳐 공격한다. 마비 상태로 만들 때가 있다.
영어설명(Description En): Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 몸속에서 파동의 힘을 끌어내 쏜다. 공격은 반드시 명중한다.
영어설명(Description En): This move does not check accuracy.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 자신의 몸을 갈아 공기의 저항을 적게 한다. 스피드를 크게 올릴 수 있다.
영어설명(Description En): Raises the user's Speed by 2 stages.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 독에 물든 촉수나 팔로 상대를 꿰찌른다. 독 상태로 만들 때가 있다.
영어설명(Description En): Has a 30% chance to poison the target.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 몸에서 악의로 가득한 무서운 오라를 발한다. 상대를 풀죽게 만들 때가 있다.
영어설명(Description En): Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 순간적으로 틈을 노려 상대를 베어 버린다. 급소에 맞기 쉽다.
영어설명(Description En): Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 세차게 날뛰는 거친 파도와 같이 큰 꼬리를 흔들어서 상대를 공격한다.
영어설명(Description En): No additional effect.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 단단한 껍질을 가지고 있는 큰 씨앗을 힘껏 내던져 상대를 공격한다.
영어설명(Description En): No additional effect.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 하늘까지 베어 가르는 공기의 칼날로 공격한다. 상대를 풀죽게 만들 때가 있다.
영어설명(Description En): Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 낫이나 발톱을 가위처럼 교차시키면서 상대를 베어 가른다.
영어설명(Description En): No additional effect.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 날개의 진동으로 음파를 일으켜서 공격한다. 상대의 특수방어를 떨어뜨릴 때가 있다.
영어설명(Description En): Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 큰 입으로 충격파를 일으켜서 상대를 공격한다.
영어설명(Description En): No additional effect.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 굉장한 살기로 위압하면서 몸통박치기한다. 상대를 풀죽게 만들 때가 있다.
영어설명(Description En): Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 보석처럼 반짝이는 빛을 발사하여 상대를 공격한다.
영어설명(Description En): No additional effect.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 주먹으로 상대의 힘을 흡수한다. 입힌 데미지의 절반에 해당하는 HP를 회복할 수 있다.
영어설명(Description En): The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 주먹을 흔들어 진공의 파도를 일으킨다. 반드시 선제공격을 할 수 있다.
영어설명(Description En): No additional effect.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 기합을 높여서 혼신의 힘을 방출한다. 상대의 특수방어를 떨어뜨릴 때가 있다.
영어설명(Description En): Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 자연으로부터 모은 생명의 힘을 발사한다. 상대의 특수방어를 떨어뜨릴 때가 있다.
영어설명(Description En): Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 날개를 접어 저공비행으로 돌격한다. 자신도 상당한 데미지를 입는다.
영어설명(Description En): If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 상대의 발밑에 대지의 힘을 방출한다. 상대의 특수방어를 떨어뜨릴 때가 있다.
영어설명(Description En): Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 눈에 보이지 않는 속도로 자신과 상대가 지닌 물건을 교환한다.
영어설명(Description En): The user swaps its held item with the target's held item. Fails if both the user and the target have no held item, or if the user is trying to give or take a Blue Orb, Red Orb, Adamant Crystal, Lustrous Globe, Griseous Core, Plate, Drive, Memory, Rusted Sword, Rusted Shield, Booster Energy, or Mask to or from a Kyogre, Groudon, Dialga, Palkia, Giratina, Arceus, Genesect, Silvally, Zacian, Zamazenta, Paradox Pokemon, or Ogerpon, respectively. In this case, Paradox Pokemon include every species with the Protosynthesis and Quark Drive Abilities, except Gouging Fire, Raging Bolt, Iron Boulder, and Iron Crown. The target is immune to this move if it has the Sticky Hold Ability.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 가진 힘을 모두 사용해서 상대에게 돌격한다. 다음 턴은 움직일 수 없다.
영어설명(Description En): If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 나쁜 일을 생각해서 머리를 활성화시킨다. 자신의 특수공격을 크게 올린다.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 초능력으로 상대를 띄운다. 3턴 동안 공격이 상대에게 맞기 쉬워진다.

영어설명(Description En): For 5 turns, the held items of all active Pokemon have no effect. An item's effect of causing forme changes is unaffected, but any other effects from such items are negated. During the effect, Fling and Natural Gift are prevented from being used by all active Pokemon. If this move is used during the effect, the effect ends.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 돌이나 구슬을 던져서 날고 있는 상대를 공격한다. 맞은 상대는 땅에 떨어진다.
영어설명(Description En): This move can hit a target using Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, or is under the effect of Sky Drop. If this move hits a target under the effect of Bounce, Fly, Magnet Rise, or Telekinesis, the effect ends. If the target is a Flying type that has not used Roost this turn or a Pokemon with the Levitate Ability, it loses its immunity to Ground-type attacks and the Arena Trap Ability as long as it remains active. During the effect, Magnet Rise fails for the target and Telekinesis fails against the target.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 강렬한 일격을 상대에게 날린다. 공격은 반드시 급소에 맞는다.
영어설명(Description En): This move is always a critical hit unless the target is under the effect of Lucky Chant or has the Battle Armor or Shell Armor Abilities.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 맞으면 튀는 불꽃으로 상대를 공격한다. 튕긴 불꽃은 옆의 상대에게도 쏟아진다.
영어설명(Description En): If this move is successful, the target's ally loses 1/16 of its maximum HP, rounded down, unless it has the Magic Guard Ability.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 오물 파도로 자신의 주위에 있는 포켓몬을 공격한다. 독 상태로 만들 때가 있다.
영어설명(Description En): Has a 10% chance to poison the target.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 신비롭고 아름다운 춤을 경쾌하게 춘다. 자신의 특수공격과 특수방어와 스피드를 올린다.
영어설명(Description En): Raises the user's Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 1 stage.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 무거운 몸으로 상대에게 부딪쳐 공격한다. 자신이 상대보다 무거울수록 위력이 올라간다.
영어설명(Description En): The power of this move depends on (user's weight / target's weight), rounded down. Power is equal to 120 if the result is 5 or more, 100 if 4, 80 if 3, 60 if 2, and 40 if 1 or less. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 이상한 전파로 주위에 있는 자신과 같은 타입의 포켓몬에게 데미지를 준다.
영어설명(Description En): The target is immune if it does not share a type with the user.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 전기 덩어리를 상대에게 부딪쳐서 공격한다. 상대보다 스피드가 빠를수록 위력이 올라간다.
영어설명(Description En): The power of this move depends on (user's current Speed / target's current Speed), rounded down. Power is equal to 150 if the result is 4 or more, 120 if 3, 80 if 2, 60 if 1, 40 if less than 1. If the target's current Speed is 0, this move's power is 40.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 많은 물을 끼얹어서 상대를 물타입으로 바꾼다.
영어설명(Description En): Causes the target to become a Water type. Fails if the target is an Arceus or a Silvally, if the target is already purely Water type, or if the target is Terastallized.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 불꽃을 둘러 상대를 공격한다. 힘을 모아서 자신의 스피드를 올린다.
영어설명(Description En): Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1 stage.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 똬리를 틀어서 집중한다. 자신의 공격과 방어와 명중률을 올린다.
영어설명(Description En): Raises the user's Attack, Defense, and accuracy by 1 stage.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 재빠른 움직임으로 상대의 다리를 노려 공격한다. 상대의 스피드를 떨어뜨린다.
영어설명(Description En): Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 상대를 녹이는 액체를 토해내서 공격한다. 상대의 특수방어를 크게 떨어뜨린다.
영어설명(Description En): Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 2 stages.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 상대의 힘을 이용한다. 싸우고 있는 상대의 공격이 높을수록 데미지가 올라간다.
영어설명(Description En): Damage is calculated using the target's Attack stat, including stat stage changes. The user's Ability, item, and burn are used as normal.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 수수께끼의 염력파를 상대에게 보낸다. 염력파를 받은 상대는 특성이 단순으로 바뀐다.
영어설명(Description En): Causes the target's Ability to become Simple. Fails if the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Simple, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Truant, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 이상한 리듬으로 춤춘다. 움직임을 흉내 내게 해서 자신과 상대의 특성을 똑같게 만든다.
영어설명(Description En): Causes the target's Ability to become the same as the user's. Fails if the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Truant, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero, or the same Ability as the user, or if the user's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Flower Gift, Forecast, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Trace, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 상대의 행동을 도와서 자신이 행동한 뒤에 바로 움직일 수 있도록 한다.
영어설명(Description En): The target makes its move immediately after the user this turn, no matter the priority of its selected move. Fails if the target would have moved next anyway, or if the target already moved this turn.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 노래로 상대를 공격한다. 함께 돌림노래를 하면 계속해서 쓸 수 있고 위력도 올라간다.
영어설명(Description En): If there are other active Pokemon that chose this move for use this turn, those Pokemon take their turn immediately after the user, in Speed order, and this move's power is 120 for each other user.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 울리는 목소리로 상대를 공격한다. 매 턴 누군가 기술을 계속해서 쓰면 위력이 올라간다.
영어설명(Description En): For every consecutive turn that this move is used by at least one Pokemon, this move's power is multiplied by the number of turns to pass, but not more than 5.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 틈을 보며 착실하게 공격한다. 상대의 능력 변화에 관계없이 데미지를 준다.
영어설명(Description En): Ignores the target's stat stage changes, including evasiveness.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 특수한 진흙 덩어리를 상대에게 내던져서 공격한다. 능력 변화를 원래대로 돌린다.
영어설명(Description En): Resets all of the target's stat stages to 0.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 축적된 파워로 상대를 공격한다. 자신의 능력이 올라가 있는 만큼 위력이 오른다.
영어설명(Description En): Power is equal to 20+(X*20), where X is the user's total stat stage changes that are greater than 0.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 자신과 같은 편을 상대의 선제공격으로부터 지킨다.
영어설명(Description En): The user and its party members are protected from attacks with original or altered priority greater than 0 made by other Pokemon, including allies, during this turn. This move modifies the same 1/X chance of being successful used by other protection moves, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used, but does not use the chance to check for failure. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn or if this move is already in effect for the user's side.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 이상한 힘으로 순간이동하여 자신과 같은 편이 있는 장소를 바꾼다.
영어설명(Description En): The user swaps positions with its ally. Fails if the user is the only Pokemon on its side. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails or if the user's last move used is not Ally Switch.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 뜨겁게 끓어오르는 물을 상대에게 발사해서 공격한다. 화상 상태로 만들 때가 있다.
영어설명(Description En): Has a 30% chance to burn the target. The target thaws out if it is frozen.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 껍질을 깨서 자신의 방어와 특수방어를 떨어뜨리지만 공격과 특수공격, 스피드를 크게 올린다.
영어설명(Description En): Lowers the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage. Raises the user's Attack, Special Attack, and Speed by 2 stages.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 치유파동을 날려서 최대 HP의 절반만큼 상대의 HP를 회복한다.
영어설명(Description En): The target restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up. If the user has the Mega Launcher Ability, the target instead restores 3/4 of its maximum HP, rounded half down.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 엎친 데 덮친 격으로 공격한다. 상태 이상인 상대에게 큰 데미지를 준다.
영어설명(Description En): Power doubles if the target has a non-volatile status condition.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 1턴째에 상대를 하늘로 끌고 가서 2턴째에 떨어뜨려 공격한다. 끌려간 상대는 움직일 수 없다.
영어설명(Description En): This attack takes the target into the air with the user on the first turn and executes on the second. Pokemon weighing 200 kg or more cannot be lifted. On the first turn, the user and the target avoid all attacks other than Gust, Hurricane, Sky Uppercut, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows, Thunder, and Twister. The user and the target cannot make a move between turns, but the target can select a move to use. This move cannot damage Flying-type Pokemon. Fails on the first turn if the target is an ally, if the target has a substitute, or if the target is using Bounce, Dig, Dive, Fly, Phantom Force, Shadow Force, or Sky Drop.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 톱니바퀴를 돌려서 자신의 공격을 올리는 것뿐만 아니라 스피드도 크게 올린다.
영어설명(Description En): Raises the user's Speed by 2 stages and its Attack by 1 stage.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 상대를 내던져서 교대할 포켓몬을 끌어낸다. 야생의 경우에는 배틀이 끝난다.
영어설명(Description En): If both the user and the target have not fainted, the target is forced to switch out and be replaced with a random unfainted ally. This effect fails if the target is under the effect of Ingrain, has the Suction Cups Ability, or this move hit a substitute.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 불꽃으로 상대를 공격한다. 상대가 나무열매 등을 지니고 있을 때 불태워서 쓸 수 없게 만든다.
영어설명(Description En): The target loses its held item if it is a Berry or a Gem. This move cannot cause Pokemon with the Sticky Hold Ability to lose their held item. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 상대를 억눌러서 행동의 순서를 마지막으로 만든다.
영어설명(Description En): Causes the target to take its turn after all other Pokemon this turn, no matter the priority of its selected move. Fails if the target already moved this turn.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 경쾌하게 상대를 공격한다. 자신이 도구를 지니고 있지 않을 때 큰 데미지를 준다.
영어설명(Description En): Power doubles if the user has no held item.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 상대의 타입을 반사해서 자신도 똑같은 타입이 된다.
영어설명(Description En): Causes the user's types to become the same as the current types of the target. If the target's current types include typeless and a non-added type, typeless is ignored. If the target's current types include typeless and an added type from Forest's Curse or Trick-or-Treat, typeless is copied as the Normal type instead. Fails if the user is an Arceus or a Silvally, if the user is Terastallized, or if the target's current type is typeless alone.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 쓰러진 같은 편의 원수를 갚는다. 앞 턴에서 같은 편이 쓰러졌다면 위력이 올라간다.
영어설명(Description En): Power doubles if one of the user's party members fainted last turn.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 목숨을 걸고 상대를 공격한다. 자신은 기절하게 되지만 상대에게 HP만큼의 데미지를 준다.
영어설명(Description En): Deals damage to the target equal to the user's current HP. If this move is successful, the user faints.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 상대가 도구를 지니고 있지 않을 때 자신이 지니고 있는 도구를 상대에게 건넨다.
영어설명(Description En): The target receives the user's held item. Fails if the user has no item or is holding a Z-Crystal, if the target is already holding an item, if the item is a Mega Stone and either the user or the target is the species that can Mega Evolve with it, or if the item is a Blue Orb, Red Orb, Griseous Orb, Plate, Drive, or Memory and either the user or the target is a Kyogre, Groudon, Giratina, Arceus, Genesect, or Silvally, respectively.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 격렬한 불꽃으로 상대를 둘러싸 공격한다. 화상 상태로 만든다.
영어설명(Description En): Has a 100% chance to burn the target.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 물기둥으로 공격한다. 불꽃과 조합하면 위력이 올라가고 하늘에 무지개가 걸린다.
영어설명(Description En): If one of the user's allies chose to use Fire Pledge or Grass Pledge this turn and has not moved yet, it takes its turn immediately after the user and the user's move does nothing. If combined with Fire Pledge, the ally uses Water Pledge with 150 power and a rainbow appears on the user's side for 4 turns, which doubles secondary effect chances and stacks with the Serene Grace Ability, except effects that cause flinching can only have their chance doubled once. If combined with Grass Pledge, the ally uses Grass Pledge with 150 power and a swamp appears on the target's side for 4 turns, which quarters the Speed of each Pokemon on that side. When used as a combined move, this move gains STAB no matter what the user's type is. This move does not consume the user's Water Gem, and cannot be redirected by the Storm Drain Ability.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 불꽃기둥으로 공격한다. 풀과 조합하면 위력이 올라가고 주위가 불바다가 된다.
영어설명(Description En): If one of the user's allies chose to use Grass Pledge or Water Pledge this turn and has not moved yet, it takes its turn immediately after the user and the user's move does nothing. If combined with Grass Pledge, the ally uses Fire Pledge with 150 power and a sea of fire appears on the target's side for 4 turns, which causes damage to non-Fire types equal to 1/8 of their maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect, including the last turn. If combined with Water Pledge, the ally uses Water Pledge with 150 power and a rainbow appears on the user's side for 4 turns, which doubles secondary effect chances and stacks with the Serene Grace Ability, except effects that cause flinching can only have their chance doubled once. When used as a combined move, this move gains STAB no matter what the user's type is. This move does not consume the user's Fire Gem.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 풀기둥으로 공격한다. 물과 조합하면 위력이 올라가고 주변이 습지초원이 된다.
영어설명(Description En): If one of the user's allies chose to use Fire Pledge or Water Pledge this turn and has not moved yet, it takes its turn immediately after the user and the user's move does nothing. If combined with Fire Pledge, the ally uses Fire Pledge with 150 power and a sea of fire appears on the target's side for 4 turns, which causes damage to non-Fire types equal to 1/8 of their maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect, including the last turn. If combined with Water Pledge, the ally uses Grass Pledge with 150 power and a swamp appears on the target's side for 4 turns, which quarters the Speed of each Pokemon on that side. When used as a combined move, this move gains STAB no matter what the user's type is. This move does not consume the user's Grass Gem.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 공격한 뒤 굉장한 스피드로 돌아와서 교대 포켓몬과 교체한다.
영어설명(Description En): If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members, or if the target switched out using an Eject Button or through the effect of the Emergency Exit or Wimp Out Abilities.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 저항해서 상대를 공격한다. 상대의 특수공격을 떨어뜨린다.
영어설명(Description En): Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 땅을 힘껏 밟아 자신의 주위에 있는 포켓몬을 공격한다. 상대의 스피드를 떨어뜨린다.
영어설명(Description En): Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 차가운 숨결을 상대에게 내뿜어 공격한다. 반드시 급소에 맞는다.
영어설명(Description En): This move is always a critical hit unless the target is under the effect of Lucky Chant or has the Battle Armor or Shell Armor Abilities.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 상대를 튕겨내서 교대할 포켓몬을 끌어낸다. 야생의 경우에는 배틀이 끝난다.
영어설명(Description En): If both the user and the target have not fainted, the target is forced to switch out and be replaced with a random unfainted ally. This effect fails if the target used Ingrain previously, has the Suction Cups Ability, or this move hit a substitute.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 스스로 분발해서 공격과 특수공격을 올린다.
영어설명(Description En): Raises the user's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 전기 네트로 상대를 붙잡아서 공격한다. 상대의 스피드를 떨어뜨린다.
영어설명(Description En): Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 전기를 두르고 상대에게 부딪쳐 공격한다. 자신도 조금 데미지를 입는다.
영어설명(Description En): If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 1/4 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 드릴처럼 몸을 회전시켜서 상대에게 몸통박치기한다. 급소에 맞기 쉽다.
영어설명(Description En): Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 몸의 단단한 부분으로 상대를 때려 공격한다. 2회 연속으로 데미지를 준다.
영어설명(Description En): Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 귀여운 모습으로 방심시켜서 강렬한 일격을 날린다. 상대를 풀죽게 만들 때가 있다.
영어설명(Description En): Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.

한국어설명(Description Ko): 뿔을 꿰찔러서 상대의 양분을 흡수한다. 입힌 데미지의 절반에 해당하는 HP를 회복할 수 있다.
